mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM sys_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT calendar_id, tenant_id, calendar_code, calendar_name, region, default_flag, weekly_rest_days, work_start_time, work_end_time, lunch_start_time, lunch_end_time, status, remark, deleted, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM sys_holiday_calendar WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND default_flag = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND calendar_id <> #{exceptId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT calendar_id FROM sys_holiday_calendar WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_holiday_date (tenant_id, calendar_id, holiday_date, date_type, holiday_name, triple_pay_flag, year_no, remark, deleted, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{row.tenantId}, #{row.calendarId}, #{row.holidayDate}, #{row.dateType}, #{row.holidayName}, #{row.triplePayFlag}, #{row.yearNo}, #{row.remark}, 0, 0, #{row.createBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateBy}, #{row.updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE date_type = VALUES(date_type), holiday_name = VALUES(holiday_name), triple_pay_flag = VALUES(triple_pay_flag), year_no = VALUES(year_no), remark = VALUES(remark), deleted = 0, version = version + 1, update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
